# Header

`email/header` &middot; section-level &middot; category: email

## Purpose

Logo bar at the top of an email, using the brand logo (and dark-mode logo when defined), with optional navigation links.

## Required fields

None.

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nav` | links |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered logo. Pass nav for a link row beneath it.
- **left**: Left-aligned logo. Sets `align: left`.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `linkColor` | color | `"@colors.text"` |
| `navGap` | length | `"@spacing.md"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingTight @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Always shows the light logo. | May auto-invert colors, use a logo that reads on both. | Swaps to dark.logoUrl where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('email/header', {
  "nav": [
    {
      "label": "New",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/new"
    },
    {
      "label": "Women",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/women"
    },
    {
      "label": "Men",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/men"
    },
    {
      "label": "Sale",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/sale"
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
